title: Maker-side EV vs reaction speed R (GO/NO-GO for market-making infrastructure)
status: FROZEN AT REGISTRATION - no bar moves after this file is written. Divergence => report + INSUFFICIENT, never improvise.
why: Inverts U1: takers lose 6-10c/round-trip at real crossing prices; that money flows to makers. Measures whether a maker with reaction speed R collects it or adverse selection eats it. Not a strategy backtest.
queue_position_asymmetry: Tape fills went to FRONT-of-queue makers; a new entrant sits at the BACK where informed sweeps concentrate. Every measured EV is an OPTIMISTIC bound. Frozen consequence: negative pool EV = decisive KILL; positive = necessary-but-not-sufficient, next step tiny-size live validation only, never a scaled build.

archive_bounds_measured_before_freeze.source: venue_expansion/cache/prereg/ticker_dim.parquet (all 4 market shards) + cache/prereg/tape/u1_day_shard=*.parquet (all 16 trade shards, U1 [3,97] admission band)

bonferroni.family: Stage B gated cells ONLY. Stages A and C are descriptive, carry no bar, and nothing in them may be promoted post hoc; any hypothesis they suggest requires a NEW registration.
bonferroni.cells: R{1,5,15,60,300s} x theta{5bp,10bp} x asset{BTC,ETH} = 20 gated hypotheses, one day-clustered t per cell on volume-weighted UNEXPLAINED-fill maker EV.
bonferroni.alpha: FWER 0.05 two-sided, Bonferroni m=20 => per-cell two-sided alpha = 0.0025. No FDR/BH, no one-sided test anywhere.
bonferroni.bar: Exact Student-t quantile at p=0.99875 at realized df = n_distinct_UTC_days - 1 per cell (never the z=3.0233).
bonferroni.plausible_realized: BTC cells df 451-456 => bar ~3.0404-3.0402; ETH cells df 414-435 => bar ~3.0420-3.0411. Realized-df exact quantile IS the bar; the table is illustrative and df variation alone is not a divergence.
bonferroni.sign_rule: PASS requires SIGNED t >= +bar. Negative t clearing the magnitude is evidence for KILL, never PASS (U1 lesson: |t| gating advanced structurally dead negatives).

stageA.role: MAKER POOL MAP - descriptive, no significance bar, no promotable claims.
stageA.data_plan: One combined pass (shared with Stage B extraction) over ALL 16 trade shards trades-0000..0015 (explicit path list; HTTP globs 404), joined to cached ticker_dim.parquet. series_key parsed from event_ticker with the exact U1 build_dim rule - exact keys, never prefix LIKE (the #34 family-conflation guard). Settled markets only (archive result in {yes,no}); every other result => skip ledger with reason. Per-shard partial aggregates cached under venue_expansion/cache/mm1/stageA/ and resumable. Category from markets shards where present else live /trade-api/v2/series/{series_key}, cached. fee_type verified LIVE per series used, cached to cache/mm1/fee_types.json; maker fee applied ONLY where the venue charges one (quadratic => maker $0; quadratic_with_maker_fees => published maker fee); fee-unresolvable series reported in a separate fee-unverified bucket, never merged.
stageA.accounting: Every tape print is a maker fill on its passive side. taker_side='yes' at yes_price p cents => maker SHORT YES at p: P&L/ct = p - 100*[result=='yes'] cents, minus maker fee where charged. taker_side='no' at no_price q => maker SHORT NO at q: P&L/ct = q - 100*[result=='no'] cents, minus maker fee where charged. Outcomes ONLY from the archive result field. Volume-weighted (per-contract, weight=count) PRIMARY; per-fill means sensitivity only. Frozen maker-short-price bands (cents): [1,5),[5,10),[10,20),[20,35),[35,50),[50,65),[65,80),[80,90),[90,95),[95,99].
stageA.outputs: venue_expansion/out/mm1_pool_map.json + cache/mm1/stageA/pool.parquet: category x band x calendar year x maker-short-side: n prints, contracts, $/ct net, total $ pool, day count. Feeds capacity estimate only.

stageB.universe: series_key in {KXBTC, KXBTCD, KXETH, KXETHD} EXACT (KXBTC15M/KXETH15M and all MAX/MIN/monthly/annual crypto series EXCLUDED). Settled markets, fills 2024-10-24..2026-01-28 (bounded from archive). Asset cells POOL the two series per asset: BTC = KXBTC|B + KXBTCD|T; ETH = KXETH|B + KXETHD|T; per-series breakdown reported as unbarred sensitivity. Admission: maker short price in [3,97] cents (mirrors U1 for reconciliation). Fees: verify fee_type live for all 4 series (expected quadratic => maker $0); if any differs, apply published maker fee and disclose. Spot clock: Binance 1s klines BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT. Disclosed basis caveat: Kalshi crypto settles on CME BRTI; Binance is the observable-information reference only, never a settlement source.
stageB.classification: Pre-fill info only. Fill at epoch t, k=floor(t) UTC seconds. head = close of 1s kline open-second k-1 (completed strictly before fill); base = close of kline open-second k-1-R; r = ln(head/base). EXPLAINED at (R,theta) iff |r| >= theta, SIDE-AGNOSTIC (a real maker cancels on ANY large move; also removes bracket-rung direction ambiguity); else UNEXPLAINED. Missing klines: last available close within a 5s grace window ending at the required second, head and base independently; if either still missing => UNJOINABLE => skip ledger (never classified); UNJOINABLE contracts > 5% of an asset's admitted contracts => that asset INSUFFICIENT. Directional toward-taker variant (threshold rungs only) reported as unbarred sensitivity. Disclosed: zero-decision-latency assumption beyond 1s kline granularity; R=1s is the infrastructure-speed bound.
stageB.merge_strategy: (1) 16-shard pass (shared with Stage A) extracts all 4-series fills to per-UTC-day parquet cache/mm1/fills/day=YYYY-MM-DD.parquet sorted by created_time (~870K rows total); per-shard partials cached, resumable. (2) Binance daily 1s zips, 2 assets x 462 days (~2.7GB zipped), sequential polite fetch, resume-safe, cache/mm1/binance/{asset}/{date}.zip, reduced to per-day (second, close) parquet. (3) Per-day vectorized second-indexed array lookup of s[k-1] and s[k-1-R] (previous day loaded for midnight-crossing lookback) computes all 10 (R,theta) flags per fill in one pass; per-day classified parquet persisted immediately. (4) Per-day per-cell aggregates -> t-stats. One session; every step resumable after container restart.
stageB.ev_accounting: Same identity accounting as Stage A (short-YES at p / short-NO at q vs archive result; maker fee per verified fee_type). Primary estimator: contract-weighted mean EV/ct. Inference: cluster by UTC calendar day of created_time; cluster-robust ratio-estimator SE on per-day (sum weighted P&L, sum weights) as implemented in U1; t = EV_w/SE, df = n_days-1. Per cell report: EV all / EV explained / EV unexplained (all volume-weighted, net), surviving volume share = unexplained contracts / all admitted contracts for the asset, n prints, contracts, n days.
stageB.min_n_frozen: Per cell, UNEXPLAINED leg must have >= 150 distinct UTC days AND >= 2000 prints AND >= 200000 contracts, else the cell is INSUFFICIENT (neither PASS nor a KILL vote). Floors set against measured density (BTC ~122M in-band contracts/457d; ETH ~24.5M/436d): they bind only if theta removes nearly everything, in which case the 20% surviving-volume PASS floor has already failed.
stageB.pass: Cell PASS iff ALL: (1) volume-weighted UNEXPLAINED maker EV >= +0.5 c/ct net; (2) signed day-clustered t >= + exact alpha=0.0025 quantile at realized df; (3) surviving volume >= 20% of the asset's admitted contracts; (4) min_n met; (5) sanity anchors hold. Asset PASS iff >=1 of its 10 cells passes; study PASS iff >=1 asset passes. FROZEN INTERPRETATION: a PASS is necessary-but-not-sufficient (front-of-queue optimistic bound); only permitted next step is separately-registered tiny-size live validation. NEVER a scaled build from this study alone.
stageB.kill: Decisive per-asset KILL iff volume-weighted ALL-FILLS maker EV net <= 0 c/ct for that asset - the optimistic pool bound failed; fires regardless of any cell. Also asset KILL if no cell passes AND every cell with unexplained EV > 0 fails the 20% surviving-volume floor (no business left after filtering). Study verdict: PASS if >=1 asset PASS; else KILL if all assets KILL; else INSUFFICIENT with per-cell reasons. A KILL is a fine result (41/41 base rate); a positive is more likely a bug until the anchors clear.

sanity_anchors.a_u1_reconciliation: On each overlapping unit-side (KXBTC|B, KXBTCD|T, KXETH|B, KXETHD|T x yes/no, [3,97] band): all-fills maker GROSS EV/ct must equal minus the U1 taker GROSS EV/ct (U1 net + taker fee) recomputed from cache/prereg/tape/u1_day_shard=*.parquet, |diff| <= 0.05 c/ct. Breach => accounting bug => halt, INSUFFICIENT until reconciled.
sanity_anchors.b_clock_check: At (R=60s, theta=10bp) per asset: EXPLAINED volume-weighted EV must be < 0 AND < UNEXPLAINED EV - 1.0 c/ct. Violation => classification clock/join broken => all cells INSUFFICIENT pending fix; bars do not move.
sanity_anchors.c_reporting: n, contracts, day counts published for ALL 20 cells regardless of outcome; every skip logged with reason; partial results written per processed day under cache/mm1/.

stageC.role: SPREAD/QUOTE CONTEXT - descriptive, no bar, outside the Bonferroni family.
stageC.data_plan: 200 markets uniform random (frozen seed 20260730) from KXBTC hourly markets with close_time in 2026-06-01..2026-06-30 UTC (most recent complete month; candlesticks cover recent months while the tape ends 2026-01-28 - era mismatch disclosed). GET /trade-api/v2/series/KXBTC/markets/{ticker}/candlesticks?period_interval=1 over each market's final 6h; cached cache/mm1/candles/, polite sequential fetch.
stageC.outputs: Quoted spread (yes_ask - yes_bid) distribution p25/50/75/90, share of minutes with two-sided quotes, per-minute touch-move frequency, split by hours-to-close bucket. Feeds ONLY the infrastructure quote-cadence statement; no EV claim, nothing promotable.

deliverable: Go/no-go with numbers: 'a maker reacting within R keeps X c/ct on Y% of flow, worth ~$Z/mo at measured surviving volumes (OPTIMISTIC front-of-queue bound)' or 'dead even at the optimistic bound'. Capacity math uses measured surviving contracts only, never hope.
